kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Rs 44.29 per share: the objects floor, i.e. identified objects of Rs 155.03 cr divided by the fixed fresh issue of 3.50 crore shares, before offer expenses and general corporate purposes (pp. 134-135). Not a price band. The last secondary transfers (Apr-Jun 2026) were at Rs 17.50 (p. 207).

focus.title: Cash flow vs profit
focus.detail: Operating cash flow -5.90 / -6.59 / +2.67 cr (FY24/25/26) against PAT 8.63 / 16.14 / 13.38 cr: cumulative CFO/PAT -25.7%. Capital advances (+Rs 9.59 cr FY26, +Rs 13.52 cr FY25) appear to sit inside operating cash flow rather than investing (balance-sheet movements match the 'other non-financial assets' line); adding them back gives FY26 +12.26 and FY25 +6.93 cr, still below PAT.

focus.title: Related-party capex & subsidiaries
focus.detail: Purchases and cost of services from KMP-influenced entities Rs 14.11 cr in FY26 (24.3% of gross purchases of Rs 58.10 cr; 30.6% in FY25). Advances to related-party suppliers Rs 8.06 cr at FY26 (Rs 1.20 cr FY25), 11.5% of net worth. Farmers City International (apparently the subsidiary sold in FY25) now supplies the company. Capital advances Rs 25.81 cr (36.7% of net worth) are unreconciled to named vendors.

focus.title: Customer / supplier / geographic concentration
focus.detail: Top-1 customer 18.73%, top-5 71.13%, top-10 83.58% of FY26 revenue (88.55% FY24); names withheld for want of consent. Top-1 supplier 20.20%, top-10 69.66%, and three FY26 supplier amounts equal those of related parties; no supply contract disclosed. Delhi alone is 58.47% of FY26 revenue.

focus.title: Bonus issue / share-count consistency
focus.detail: Bonus (1.5:1, Jun-2023) and 5-for-1 split (Sep-2023) fall inside FY24. Basis for Issue Price p. 202 prints FY24 basic EPS Rs 20.41 on the pre-split count (42.05 lakh shares) next to Rs 1.91 and Rs 1.50 on 8.98 crore shares, giving a basic weighted EPS of Rs 4.79; on one share base (FY24 Rs 1.76) it is about Rs 1.68. EPS numerators use total comprehensive income (FY26 Rs 13.51 cr vs PAT Rs 13.38 cr).

focus.title: Current vs deferred tax
focus.detail: Current tax 4.76 / 7.33 / 5.47 cr (FY24/25/26) = 32.0% of cumulative PBT, so profit is taxed. But income tax paid (net) is Rs 11.07 cr against Rs 17.56 cr charged; the current-tax liability stands at Rs 6.86 cr at 31-Mar-2026.

focus.title: Objects arithmetic as price floor
focus.detail: Objects need Rs 155.03 cr (Rs 20.00 cr debt repayment, Rs 135.03 cr capex) against a fixed fresh issue of 3.50 crore shares: price floor at least Rs 44.29 before offer expenses and GCP (up to 25% of gross). Last secondary transfers were at Rs 17.50 (p. 207); floor is 2.5x that.

focus.title: Contingent liabilities
focus.detail: No contingent liabilities, but capital commitments of Rs 17.41 cr (Rs 1.49 cr FY25) are not provided for. One FIR (No. 33/2025, s. 420 IPC) is under investigation with notice issued to a director (pp. 447-448).

focus.title: Auditor qualifications / changes
focus.detail: NKSC & Co appointed statutory auditor 30-Aug-2023; the document records no change since. Audit reports on the FY24 and FY25 consolidated statements were not reviewed in this pass.
